summary: A practice firmware for Indian classical music: a modelled tanpura, a tabla that plays ten taals, and a reference tone, all on one screen. AI-written and so far tested only in emulators.
features: Physical-model tanpura with jawari buzz; four strings, tunable Sa and A reference
Sampled tabla tuned to Sa, ten taals from Teentaal to Chautaal
Tempo 20 to 600 matras a minute; screen marks sam and khali
New taals can be added as small text files
Sine reference tone on any swara over three octaves
Version 1.0, not yet tried on a real FM-1
